description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Admin_UI_Hooks, which manages UI-related hooks and event listeners for the Revive Adserver project. It provides methods for registering callbacks and triggering events at various points in the UI rendering process, such as before and after page headers and content.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Hooks
classes.description: A manager class for registering and triggering UI event hooks in the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: beforePageHeader
methods.description: Triggers the 'beforePageHeader' event with context data including page ID, page data, and optional header model.

methods.name: registerBeforePageHeaderListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the 'beforePageHeader' event occurs.

methods.name: afterPageHeader
methods.description: Triggers the 'afterPageHeader' event with context data including page ID.

methods.name: registerAfterPageHeaderListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'afterPageHeader' event.

methods.name: beforePageContent
methods.description: Triggers the 'beforePageContent' event, returning HTML content to inject before page content.

methods.name: registerBeforePageContentListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'beforePageContent' event.

methods.name: afterPageContent
methods.description: Triggers the 'afterPageContent' event, returning HTML content to inject after page content.

methods.name: registerAfterPageContentListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'afterPageContent' event.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the event dispatcher.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the hooks by registering UI listeners from plugins, called once per request.
